task.summary: Default task
Run renderer in parallel.
Added X, Y debug labels to scene view. This is not rendered.

Large refactor with rotations. We had a mix between different rotations and methods to get angle between them leading to bugs.
Reversed render directions in renderer.

Large refactor with rotations. We had a mix between different rotations and methods to get angle between them leading to bugs.
Reversed render directions in renderer.
Ignore optional render output folder.
Modified the spawn function for a simpler interface. Now checks if spawning on floor as an optioanl argument.
Added item modifiers which add an onhit ability activator. Modified abilities to support on hit activation.
Cleaned up unused entity.

Replaced AbilityItemNodeDescriptor with AbilityDescriptor which acts more like a generator class to simplify nodes. Fixed issue where abilities were not connecting to resource pools. Made invisible abilities not visible in the view.
NOTE - Abilities do not spawn entities.
Fixed issue where onhit spawns would crash due to not suspending defer. Added warning Removed emitters - abilities are now spawned as direct flecs.
Fixed issue where onhit spawns would crash due to not suspending defer. Added warning Removed emitters - abilities are now spawned as direct flecs.
Completed refactor of player abilities and how they connect. New system has less hardcoded details at odd levels. UI elements are now optional.
Fixed issue where ability textures were not updating in UI.
Cleaned up resource UI to a single reuseable type for both mana and stamina.
Added type to error when godot finds a class which does not exist. Happens usually when refactoring.
Removed spawned projectiles when unequipping an item. This is to avoid projectiles having references to now cleared abilities.
Separated on hit and onkill modifiers. Added more descriptive context for damage. This is really poorly done and needs ripping out when I replace damage/spawning system with a simpler pattern.
Removed unused flecs world. Added additional logging to flecs. Enabled flecs explorer support.
Diabling test to build.
Diabling test to build.

Updated to 4.6 ( 6fd949a6dcbda ) Shapes in the physics engine now calculate their AABB shape at end of frame when events are flushed. Moved creation of physics map shape so AABB exists when later used.
Updated to 4.6 ( 6fd949a6dcbda ) UNIT TESTING - Added changes which prevents base godot unit test from always being used.

Updated to 4.6 ( 6fd949a6dcbda ) BASE FILES UPDATED - automatic changes godot made. - Named physical layers for collision. Functionally same. - Fixed bug with setting up world collision if using delay. With delay it would never set up.
Added frame yields before and after each game test. This allows things to leave the world properly.
Moved flecs world to node creation.
Added yields to subcases ending. This fixes an issue where last frame objects that left tree still exist.

Added unit tests which create equipped items and verify if enemies are killed by spawned abilities.
Added variety of constructors. Did not realize this was a valid pattern for godot. These are used for runtime generated resources.
Added collision raycasting for testing scene helper.
Added player resource regeneration for stamina and mana.
Added prefab spawn counts. Useful for test debugging.
Added ability to query for entities near a point for tests.
Added collision and pathfinding tests. Removed old test case file. Removed debug logging from gdscript.
Added max delta time option.
Added on hit ability test.
More unit tests. This should be final group.
Animation maker mild changes for play changes. Now use reset animation but may revert this.
Leftover commits. Removed old gd.
Added unfinished ability description sequence. Split description for resources to a base type.
Removed separate ability resources and merged into a common type.
Added cooldown time to abilities. Refactored abilities to use descriptor more.
Added test case for ability cooldown
Abilities now sequence correctly.
Add BIND_GETSET_enum type.

Applied formatting to descriptor and activator_base files.
Added sequencing timing. Abilities can now sequence and break if took too long.
Added ability to use custom ability with test weapon function. Improved timing for test cases. Fixed warnings for PlayerComposition due to checking for nullptr instead of using ref function.
Added 2x test cases for ability testing. Added safety check for curve not being set in sequence.
Ran formatter on several files. no changes.
Disabled debug mesh saving.
Sequence must wait for cooldown to end.
Added scaled time to main. Stop compiling after 1 error.
